_comment: Copy this file to config/watchlist.json (gitignored). Replace the placeholders with handles you track, without @. Optional object form also works: {"handle": "example_account", "notes": "why you watch them"}. trend_input_only = accounts (e.g. a big aggregator) whose posts are fetched and used ONLY as trend signals: never shown as hits, outsiders, leaderboard rows or drafts. lang = en|ru for board/ping labels. experiment = optional trend vs non-trend tracker of YOUR own posts (fill handle + numeric user_id, set enabled true). x_keywords.core = ~16 niche keywords for the X keyword table (24h vs previous 24h, sampled search).
